args: In selinux/libsepol/cil/src/cil_binary.c, what is the correct architectural limit and error-handling pattern when policydb type/class IDs passed to __cil_insert_avrule exceed avtab_key_t's 16-bit fields? Are there existing validation checks elsewhere in CIL policy generation, and should validation be done in __cil_insert_avrule itself?

The supplied sanitizer report shows that __cil_insert_avrule receives uint32_t src=65536 from a generated type/type-attribute, assigns it into avtab_key_t.source_type (a 16-bit field), producing zero, and later neverallow checking indexes attr_type_map[source_type - 1], causing a heap-buffer-overflow. The known trigger amplifies symbols via block inheritance beyond 65535. I am investigating a root-cause range check in __cil_insert_avrule before narrowing src, tgt, and obj. I also want to preserve established return/error conventions and determine whether a similar helper or policy-wide limit already exists. No patch has yet been applied.
